name: Orbs / wormhole
description: A ring of glossy 3D orbs rotating in space that funnels into a wormhole as the scene runs. The `wormhole` parameter morphs between the two, so one scene can start as an orbiting ring and end as a tunnel.

wormhole.description: 0 = a rotating ring of orbs, 1 = orbs funnelling into a wormhole. Never starts at a flat 0: a single ring with no tunnel behind it is the one framing of this effect that leaves most of the frame empty. Spread across most of the scene so the change is a drift rather than a lurch; set it to a constant to hold either state.

spread.description: Ring radius. Wide enough by default that the ring passes outside the frame edges rather than sitting inside them as a hoop.

speed.description: Rings pass at speed/1.9 per second. Above ~1.5 it reads as a hurtling tunnel rather than a drift.
